model_observation.scope: Actual omitted model overrides mean inherited session defaults; explicit experimental requests, where present, remain requests. The host does not expose authenticated resolved backend identities.

metrics.unavailable_reason: The session collaboration interface does not expose native per-thread token/billing/context telemetry. Values are not inferred from duration or tool counts.

limitations: One unrandomized baseline cell on a shared host. Compact reading-space tradeoff, partly English inherited shell labels, inherited approximately 1.29 MB minified JavaScript warning. Chromium emulation and synthetic IME only; no physical keyboard, screen-reader, other-engine or natural-time playback evidence. HuggingChat authenticated behavior was unobserved behind sign-in. Native resolved model, token, bill and context-pressure data are unavailable.
